notes.title: New feature - melee combat
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/3a5d592476fa60cdce8d8391c4d57737064caace.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Melee combat has now officially been added to the game! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/3965a2f8d15064cd5b42f285c8e2098b6ef4493c.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Melee combat is the newest and a very exiting addition to Grunt1914! They can be used by being selected as a weapon slot. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53f96bdc9b71066b8ee48d2bd27bbbdde208c3aa.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This update includes two melee weapons that can be used at any level. The update introduces the possibility of a range of weapons that might be bought into the game in the near future. 

In this update the two weapons that are made available are :

- The M1916 Shovel
- The M1829 Artillery sabre

This update will allow for many new ways to play the maps in the game with any game mode, and will lead to some tense and exciting battles!

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/c24d84cce2ff58f9de0826bbf52b59d481308fe3.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

This feature is due to change in the coming weeks based on player feedback and internal testing.

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

notes.title: New feature - grenades
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/3a5d592476fa60cdce8d8391c4d57737064caace.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grenades have now officially been added to the game! 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/4503a17b335eb2cdb1bc9672050db3033c4a3f17.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

Grenades are the newest and an especially exiting addition to Grunt1914! They can be used either in the traditional sense as "quick throw" items by pressing the mapped key or the can be selected as a weapon slot. 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/216244514f535650eb1045c0a90e7c20e0610fb4.png[/img]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img] 

This update includes three grenades that can be used at any level. The update introduces explosive grenades as well as smoke grenades, more grenade types will be added into the game in the future. 

In this update the three grenades that are made available are :

- The MKII Grenade
- The MKI Smoke grenade
- The Stielhandgranate 

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/34859019/53a849ebcc1b0d4e45ef03766b9c227acb4dde39.png[/img]
